(1) there are no new Higgs bosons with masses less than 500 GeV, if the 126 Ge V Higgs boson is a standard model Higgs, (2) there are no singly charged Higgses lighter than 200 Ge V, and (3) the mass of the doubly charged Higgs is at least 400 GeV.
